features.description: Ring 0 ceiling — bound AIPLA_THINKING_BUDGET (currently unset = -1 unbounded), Vertex quota override, billing budget alerts. No application code.
acceptance_criteria: AIPLA_THINKING_BUDGET is set per env in BOTH cloudbuild.yaml and cloudbuild.promote.yaml
make check-cloudbuild passes
google_service_usage_consumer_quota_override on aiplatform.googleapis.com exists per env in infrastructure/env/
google_billing_budget with 50/90/100 percent thresholds exists
Ceiling numbers recorded in an ops runbook

features.description: Access tiers — teacher_access Firestore register keyed by normalised email, access_tier custom claim reconciled at bootstrap, User.access_tier, assert_can_spend (402) on every paid entry point, no join code for visitors, SA-gated admin grant/revoke/list, CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Absent claim resolves to visitor; revoked resolves to visitor; past expiresAt resolves to visitor
Every guarded route returns 402 for a visitor and 200 for a pilot
A visitor's bootstrap seeds activities and a Demo class but mints NO join code
Email normalisation: Anna@KU.dk matches anna@ku.dk; anna+test@ku.dk does NOT match anna@ku.dk
is_teacher semantics are unchanged and all existing assert_teacher tests still pass
Revoke calls revoke_refresh_tokens so outstanding sessions drop immediately

features.description: Access request and visitor nudge — /teacher/access page in the (site) route group, visitor banner re-shown on any 402, POST /api/teacher/access-request writing an admin-reviewable queue, grant-from-queue CLI.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor reaches the request route in one click from any teacher surface
Request submission does not reveal whether an email is already on the register
The new public page lives in the (site) route group so SiteFooter is structural
make check-brand-literals passes and the route-chrome coverage test passes
aiplatform access requests lists pending requests and grant marks them granted

features.description: Recorded demo path — demo_transcripts seeded content replayed as a second AG-UI event source behind stream_agui_events, visibly labelled, off-script input gets an honest card plus the nudge rather than a fabricated answer.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor chat streams recorded turns through the unchanged chat surface
Off-script input never yields a fabricated answer — it renders the honest card
A visitor session touches no model client (patched constructors raise) — the load-bearing test
Naming avoids _mock-data, getMock and MOCK_[A-Z] so check:no-mock passes
No part reuses the LOCAL_MODE identifier in any deployed config

features.description: Per-teacher budget enforcer — FirestoreBudgetEnforcer implementing the existing BudgetEnforcer Protocol with sharded counters, registered at startup, billing identity resolving student turns to the owning teacher, spend_guard covering the ten direct-genai paths plus RAG and voice, and both fail-open behaviours inverted.
acceptance_criteria: Cap not exceeded allows; soft threshold warns; exceeded blocks
Unresolved billing identity BLOCKS (inverted from the template's fail-open no-op)
Unknown model raises rather than being priced at zero and therefore ungated
A student's turn resolves group to class to owning teacher uid
Concurrent shard writes sum correctly
Startup assertion fires if models.yaml gains a model absent from the rate card
